newsitem.title: ESTONIA: RAKVERE UNDECIDED ON INVESTMENT: REPORT.
newsitem.headline: RAKVERE UNDECIDED ON INVESTMENT: REPORT.

text.p: Rakvere meat plant is undecided over a two to three million kroon investment into a local pig producer, Simuna Ivax, Aripave said on Monday.
Rakvere meat plant's board met last Wednesday to discuss possible investment into pig producer Simuna with no decision reached, the business paper said.
Board chairman, Toomas Kouhkna, said the investment idea is possible, but he did not support the idea as he thought Simuna was too small, the paper added.
Simuna raises 1500 pigs the paper said.
The idea of supporting the producer was from from local pig producers, the paper added.
